At a glance

Challenge, approach, and result

Challenge

Reach high-achieving professionals who may be searching for answers about subtle depression symptoms, with content that is clinically grounded and sensitive.

Approach

Researched the keyword cluster, identified the shared search need, built a Primary, Secondary, and Supporting keyword map, and developed the SEO title, meta description, H1, and structure.

Result

The blog was approved and published as part of the client's owned-media program, with every section tied to what the audience was searching for.
